init.description: Set the electricity price used to derive the cost statistic reseda:[PRM]_cost_total, which you can wire into the Energy dashboard via 'Use a separate statistic for costs'. Optionally pick an entity holding the current price in €/kWh (for example a regulated-tariff sensor): each day is then priced with the value the entity had on that day, read from its recorded history. The fixed price is used for days before the entity's first recorded value and when the entity is unavailable with no history.
